Arudra Darshan rule: Ardra at sunrise during the Tamil month Margazhi; if Ardra occurs twice in the month, choose the occurrence nearer the full moon.

Sivaratri date rule: Krishna Chaturdashi at Nishita, defined as the midpoint from local sunset to next sunrise; if Chaturdashi does not reach that midpoint, use the day it occurs at sunset. The page distinguishes northern and southern month names.
